description: Browser applications and user interfaces. Framework-specific implementation remains a project decision.

rules.title: Use meaningful HTML structure
rules.guidance: MUST use native semantic elements and logical headings for content and controls. Add ARIA where needed rather than replacing working native behavior with generic elements.

rules.title: Support keyboard interaction
rules.guidance: MUST ensure interactive controls work by keyboard with visible focus and sensible focus order. Manage focus when dialogs or dynamic views change; do not trap users unexpectedly.

rules.title: Make forms understandable
rules.guidance: MUST give controls accessible names, clear instructions and associated error feedback. Do not rely solely on placeholders or color to convey meaning.

rules.title: Render untrusted content safely
rules.guidance: MUST use context-appropriate escaping through trusted rendering APIs. Avoid raw HTML insertion; sanitize approved rich content with a maintained sanitizer and review allowed contexts.
verification: XSS payload tests and sink review

rules.title: Respect server security boundaries
rules.guidance: MUST treat browser checks as usability only; the server must authorize protected actions. For cookie-authenticated state changes, follow the application's CSRF protection strategy.

rules.title: Keep state authoritative
rules.guidance: SHOULD assign clear ownership to UI state. Derive values when practical instead of duplicating synchronized state, and prevent contradictory loading or selection states.

rules.title: Represent asynchronous outcomes
rules.guidance: MUST represent loading, empty, success and failure outcomes where applicable. Check HTTP status rather than assuming resolved fetch means success. Cancel or ignore obsolete responses and provide safe recovery.

rules.title: Measure user-facing performance
rules.guidance: SHOULD measure relevant loading and interaction costs before optimizing. Avoid unnecessary asset weight and repeated expensive work; adopt project-specific budgets where justified.
rules.rationale: Optimize the user experience with evidence.

rules.title: Keep server secrets out of browsers
rules.guidance: MUST never place server credentials or privileged integration keys in browser bundles or public build-time configuration. Treat browser storage as accessible to scripts; follow the approved token and session strategy.
verification: Bundle secret scanning and session review

rules.title: Support intended viewports
rules.guidance: SHOULD keep content and controls usable on supported viewports and zoom levels. Test layout with realistic long content; do not rely on one fixed desktop size.

criteria.rubric: Pass only if the generated guidance requires semantic structure and appropriate native elements. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
Pass only if the generated guidance requires keyboard operation and visible managed focus. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.

Pass only if the generated guidance requires labels, instructions and understandable validation feedback. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.

Pass only if the generated guidance requires safe rendering and constrained rich-content handling. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.

Pass only if the generated guidance requires server enforcement and conditional CSRF protection. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.

Pass only if the generated guidance requires clear state ownership without mandating a framework. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
Pass only if the generated guidance requires meaningful status feedback and safe recovery. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
Pass only if the generated guidance requires measurement and scoped performance budgets. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.

Pass only if the generated guidance forbids shipped server secrets and distinguishes browser storage from a secret store. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.

Pass only if the generated guidance requires responsive behavior and realistic content testing. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
